final: {"prompt":"A square, edge-to-edge, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that imagines cognition through competing rhythms, revision, compression, and sudden coherence. An asymmetric concentration of densely layered midnight violet, ultramarine, and charcoal presses inward from the upper left, interrupted by sharp, irregular strokes of electric chartreuse and hot vermilion. Across the center, tangled wet-on-wet gestures repeatedly gather, dissolve, and reappear, with older marks partly scraped away and partly visible through translucent glazes. Let small passages of startling precision emerge within restless, unresolved brushwork. Toward the lower right, release the density into a broad field of pale mineral gray and warm ivory, thinly painted but subtly disturbed by faint stains and dry-brush friction. Keep this open space charged with tension. Use thick impasto against nearly bare canvas, bruised color against luminous pigment, abrupt interruptions against slow repetitions. Allow conflicting gestures to coexist without resolving into a single dominant pattern. Visceral, materially rich, unpredictable, with passages of abrasion, hesitation, insistence, and quiet. Entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Avoid shapes that resemble identifiable things. The painting fills the entire square image, with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
